body.title: Happy Birthday My Love
messages: Maybe one day, I’ll find myself saying “thank you” to you more times than I could ever count. There were moments when I felt completely lost, when disappearing for a while seemed easier than facing everything. But you always reminded me that sometimes, it’s okay to start all over again. That life is made of choices of what we choose, who we choose to become, and how we keep growing through everything life throws at us.

Thank you for reconnecting me with friends I had been meaning to reach out to for such a long time. You probably never realized that something so small could mean so much to someone. Sometimes, the smallest things can remind us that there are still people worth coming back to, and reasons to keep moving forward.
So please, keep living too. Keep choosing yourself, keep growing, and keep finding little reasons to stay. Just like how, without even realizing it, you’ve given someone else a reason to keep going.

I hope you’ll always be healthy, live a long and beautiful life, have your days made a little easier, and always find your way toward the things you deserve. I hope life is gentle with you, even on the days when you feel like you have to be strong on your own.
And I hope you get to live as freely as the fox you’ve always dreamed of. 🦊

Because deep down, I think we both know that freedom is what we’ve always wanted. Only you and I know what the storms before this looked like. We know the things we survived, the things we never had to explain, and all the little ways we’ve changed along the way.
And somehow, in the middle of all that chaos, I found you.
I hope there will always be flowers growing between your cracks. Lots of them beautiful, colorful, wild, and never meant to wither.
And whenever life gets a little too heavy, I hope you remember that you don’t always have to carry it alone.
You have me. Not because I want to hold you back, but because I want to love you in a way that still lets you be free. I want to be someone you can come home to, not someone you have to escape from.
So go wherever life takes you, chase whatever makes your heart feel alive, become whoever you want to be and if you’ll let me, I’ll happily walk beside you through it all. 🤍
Happy birthday, sweetheart. I hope this year brings you closer to the life you’ve always dreamed of. And selfishly, I hope I get to be a small part of that life for a very, very long time.
